WITH old_ids AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id FROM moi_real_price_transactions t
  WHERE NOT (source_record_key ~~ 'moi:%'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM moi_real_price_transactions canonical
          WHERE canonical.source_record_key = SUBSTRING(t.source_record_key FROM 5)))) AND NOT (source_record_key ~~ 'moi:a:n:%'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM moi_real_price_transactions canonical
          WHERE canonical.source_record_key = replace(t.source_record_key, 'moi:a:n:'::text, 'n:a:'::text) AND NOT canonical.dataset_type IS DISTINCT FROM t.dataset_type AND NOT canonical.county IS DISTINCT FROM t.county AND NOT canonical.district IS DISTINCT FROM t.district AND NOT canonical.transaction_date IS DISTINCT FROM t.transaction_date AND NOT canonical.total_price_ntd IS DISTINCT FROM t.total_price_ntd AND NOT canonical.land_area_sqm IS DISTINCT FROM t.land_area_sqm AND NOT canonical.building_area_sqm IS DISTINCT FROM t.building_area_sqm)))), new_ids AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id FROM moi_real_price_transactions t
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.moi_real_price_transactions c WHERE t.source_record_key LIKE 'moi:%' AND c.source_record_key=substring(t.source_record_key FROM 5)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.moi_real_price_transactions c WHERE t.source_record_key LIKE 'moi:a:n:%' AND c.source_record_key=replace(t.source_record_key,'moi:a:n:','n:a:') AND c.dataset_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.dataset_type AND c.county IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.county AND c.district IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.district AND c.transaction_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.transaction_date AND c.total_price_ntd IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.total_price_ntd AND c.land_area_sqm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.land_area_sqm AND c.building_area_sqm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.building_area_sqm)), differences AS ((SELECT id FROM old_ids EXCEPT SELECT id FROM new_ids) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM new_ids EXCEPT SELECT id FROM old_ids)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM old_ids) old_count,(SELECT count(*) FROM new_ids) new_count,(SELECT count(*) FROM differences) differences;
